a version floor for each member of the cache package family, applied only where the member is
installed (`.ifInstalled()`).

`.ifInstalled()` reads an undeclared member as "not used", so every family member must hold a floor
here; the `unfloored-cache-member` bad-practice names any member that does not.

## with-simple-cache 0.17.3 — the contract moved

the floor raises `with-simple-cache` to `0.17.3`. a consumer on `0.15.x` compiles against a changed
contract:

- `SimpleOnDiskCache.get()` returns `Promise<string | undefined>`; `await` each `get()` that a
  `SimpleCache<string>` consumer read synchronously
- the cache directory options lost `s3` and `directoryToPersistTo`; `directory` replaces both

the `cache-directory-options` bad-practice stamps a `// @declapract:review:` line above each retired
option it finds in `src/`.
